propwash.ui.configurator.title: Configurator
propwash.ui.tab_error: This tab crashed – see the log for details.
propwash.ui.tab_error.copy: Click here to copy the error for a bug report.
propwash.ui.tab_error.copied: Error copied – paste it into your bug report.
propwash.ui.footer.live: Changes apply to the drone instantly
propwash.ui.footer.template: No drone: template for new drones
propwash.ui.footer.read_only: View only – nothing to change on this tab
propwash.ui.guard.airborne: Configurator locked: land and disarm first.
propwash.ui.guard.armed: Configurator locked: disarm the drone first.
propwash.ui.guard.lockout: Arming disabled while the configurator is open
propwash.ui.template.applied: Tune template applied to the new drone.
propwash.ui.overview.telemetry_hint: Live telemetry appears while you are flying a drone.
propwash.ui.overview.telemetry_missing: No telemetry from the flight model.
propwash.ui.pid.reset_derived.tip: Drops the manual PID values. The flight model derives them from the build again.
propwash.ui.pid.derived_hint: Values follow the build. Editing one switches to manual.
propwash.ui.pid.template_hint: Template: PIDs are derived per build, shown here as an example.
propwash.ui.rates.preset.tip: Pick a preset – built-in or your own – and apply it with the button next to it. Deadbands are kept.
propwash.ui.settings.speed_unit.tip: Units for speed, altitude and distance in the configurator and the OSD.
propwash.ui.settings.apply_template.tip: Drones without their own tune get the template on their first flight.
propwash.ui.settings.template_live: The template is your default tune for freshly built drones.
propwash.ui.settings.template_editing: Without a drone, PID tuning and Rates edit the template directly.
propwash.ui.settings.template_empty: It is still empty – “Save as template” fills it.
propwash.ui.settings.save_template.tip: Stores this drone's current tune as the template – without manual PIDs, those depend on the build.
propwash.ui.settings.use_template.tip: Takes rates, filters and settings from the template; this drone's PIDs stay.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.type.tip: Betaflight: RC rate, super rate, expo. Actual: center rate, max rate, expo – easier to read.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.rcRate.tip: Base sensitivity over the whole stick travel.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.superRate.ti: Raises the rotation rate towards the end of the stick.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.rcExpo.tip: Softens the center without changing the max rate.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.centerRateDp: Rotation rate in °/s per stick travel around the center.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.maxRateDps.t: Rotation rate in °/s at full stick deflection.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.roll.actualExpo.t: Shapes the curve: more expo = finer around the center.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.pitch.rcRate.tip: Base sensitivity over the whole stick travel.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.pitch.superRate.t: Raises the rotation rate towards the end of the stick.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.pitch.rcExpo.tip: Softens the center without changing the max rate.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.pitch.centerRateD: Rotation rate in °/s per stick travel around the center.
Rotation rate in °/s at full stick deflection.
Shapes the curve: more expo = finer around the center.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.rcRate.tip: Base sensitivity over the whole stick travel.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.superRate.tip: Raises the rotation rate towards the end of the stick.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.rcExpo.tip: Softens the center without changing the max rate.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.centerRateDps: Rotation rate in °/s per stick travel around the center.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.maxRateDps.ti: Rotation rate in °/s at full stick deflection.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yaw.actualExpo.ti: Shapes the curve: more expo = finer around the center.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.rcDeadband.tip: Range around the stick center that counts as zero for roll and pitch.
propwash.ui.tune.rates.yawDeadband.tip: Range around the stick center that counts as zero for yaw.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.roll.p.tip: How strongly the controller reacts to errors. Too much: oscillation, too little: mushy.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.roll.i.tip: Holds attitude against lasting disturbances such as wind or an off-center weight.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.roll.d.tip: Damps overshoot but amplifies noise and motor heat.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.roll.ff.tip: Feedforward: reacts directly to stick movement for a crisp response.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.pitch.p.tip: How strongly the controller reacts to errors. Too much: oscillation, too little: mushy.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.pitch.i.tip: Holds attitude against lasting disturbances such as wind or an off-center weight.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.pitch.d.tip: Damps overshoot but amplifies noise and motor heat.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.pitch.ff.tip: Feedforward: reacts directly to stick movement for a crisp response.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.yaw.p.tip: How strongly the controller reacts to errors. Too much: oscillation, too little: mushy.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.yaw.i.tip: Holds attitude against lasting disturbances such as wind or an off-center weight.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.yaw.d.tip: Damps overshoot but amplifies noise and motor heat.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.yaw.ff.tip: Feedforward: reacts directly to stick movement for a crisp response.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.angleStrength.tip: How firmly angle mode pulls back to level.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.horizonStrength.tip: Self-leveling in horizon mode around the stick center.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.itermRelax.tip: Holds back the I-term during fast moves and prevents bounce-back after flips.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.antiGravityGain.tip: Boosts the I-term on fast throttle changes against pitch dips.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.tpaMode.tip: Which terms get attenuated at high throttle.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.tpaRatePercent.tip: How much the PIDs are attenuated at full throttle.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.airmode.tip: Full control even at zero throttle – needed for flips and rolls.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.motorIdlePercent.ti: Motor speed at zero throttle while armed.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.throttleMid.tip: Stick point the throttle expo pivots around.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.throttleExpo.tip: Finer throttle control around throttle mid.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.throttleLimitType.t: Limits throttle: scales the whole travel or clips the top.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.throttleLimitPercen: Maximum throttle when the limit is active.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.thrustLinearPercent: Compensates the propellers' non-linear thrust curve.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.vbatSagCompensation: Keeps the flight feel constant as the battery voltage drops.
propwash.ui.tune.filters.pidLoop.tip: How often the controller runs per second. Faster = more direct.
propwash.ui.tune.filters.gyroLpfHz.tip: Filters gyro noise. Lower = smoother but more delay. Changes the derived PIDs.
propwash.ui.footer.held: Changes are saved to the drone in your hand
propwash.ui.footer.game: Game setting – applies to all drones
propwash.ui.settings.craft_name.tip: Name of the drone, shown in the OSD, on the remote and on the goggles. Saved in the drone.
propwash.ui.settings.craft_name.hint: The name is saved in the drone (up to 24 characters). A name tag on the placed drone or an anvil works too.
propwash.ui.settings.craft_name.hint_non: Hold a drone or fly one to give it a name. A name tag on a placed drone or an anvil works too.
propwash.ui.tune.pid.armMaxAngleDeg.tip: How far the drone may be tilted when you arm it (like small_angle in Betaflight). Default 25°. 180° lets you arm in any attitude – even in the air and upside down, for example to keep flying after disarming mid-flight. The throttle still has to be fully down (centered in 3D mode). Applies to this drone and travels with its tune.
propwash.ui.settings.arm_angle.limit: Arming works up to %s° of tilt; tilted further, the drone reports “not level”.
propwash.ui.settings.arm_angle.any: 180°: arm in any attitude – even in the air and upside down (throttle still fully down).
propwash.ui.settings.arm_angle.level: 0°: arm only when exactly level – practically never.
propwash.ui.footer.mixed: Name: saved in the drone · everything else: all drones
propwash.ui.settings.template_empty_edit: It is still empty – the values you change there fill it.
propwash.ui.led.installed: Installed: %s with %s LEDs under the nose. Like in Betaflight, the settings live in the drone's flight controller.
propwash.ui.led.missing: This drone has no LED strip. Put one into the bottom accessory slot of the workbench – the settings are stored in the drone anyway.
propwash.ui.led.no_drone: No drone in your hand: the settings go into the template for new drones.
propwash.ui.led.mode.tip: How the LEDs light up – like Betaflight's LED_STRIP functions: static, blinking, arm status, low-battery warning or rainbow.
propwash.ui.led.color.tip: LED color: click a swatch or use the arrow keys. Has no effect in rainbow mode.
propwash.ui.led.brightness.tip: Brightness of the LEDs and therefore of the FPV headlight.
propwash.ui.led.headlight.tip: In the dark, the strip brightens the FPV view in a light cone in front of the drone. To turn it off just for you: “Video” tab, “LED lighting in FPV view”.
propwash.ui.led.preview_armed.tip: Shows the preview as if the drone were armed (matters for the “Arm status” mode).
propwash.ui.led.desc.static: Static: the LEDs always shine in the chosen color.
propwash.ui.led.desc.blink: Blink: on and off twice per second – helps you spot the drone in the air and after a crash.
propwash.ui.led.desc.armed: Arm status: disarmed, the LEDs pulse slowly in green; armed, they shine steadily in the chosen color.
propwash.ui.led.desc.low_battery: Low battery: the LEDs shine in the chosen color and blink orange once the battery drops below 20%.
propwash.ui.led.desc.rainbow: Rainbow: the colors run along the whole strip.
propwash.ui.led.headlight_desc: Headlight on: in caves and at night the strip casts a light cone forward in the FPV view. Near surfaces get brighter than far ones; color and brightness come from the settings above.
propwash.ui.led.headlight_off: Headlight off: the LEDs only work as a marker, the FPV view stays dark in the dark.
propwash.ui.led.switch_hint: Switch them on and off in flight: the “%s” switch on your radio (tab “Modes”) or the %s key – other players see the drone go dark too. Without an assignment the LEDs always glow.
propwash.ui.led.world.ldl_present: LambDynamicLights detected: the drone is also a real light source in the world – for every player who has the mod installed.
propwash.ui.led.world.ldl_missing: With the optional mod LambDynamicLights the drone also lights up the world as a real light source. Without it, the light only affects the FPV view.
propwash.ui.led.world.shaders: Shader pack active: the headlight only brightens the FPV view as a cone in the middle of the image (no distance), fully black areas stay dark. For real light with shaders, install LambDynamicLights.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.altP.tip: How firmly ALTHOLD pulls back to the held altitude.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.altI.tip: Slowly removes steady errors such as weight, battery voltage or downdrafts.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.altD.tip: Damps climbing and sinking so the drone does not pump.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.climbRateCms.tip: Highest climb and descent rate at full or zero throttle.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.throttleDeadbandPe: How far the throttle may wander around the hold position before the drone climbs or descends.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.midThrottle.tip: On: stick center holds altitude (like Betaflight). Off: the throttle position when switched on holds altitude (like INAV).
propwash.ui.tune.hold.posP.tip: How strongly POSHOLD pulls back to the stored spot.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.posD.tip: Brakes the drone so it does not overshoot the spot.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.posMaxAngleDeg.tip: Largest tilt POSHOLD uses to correct or brake.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.stickDeadbandPerce: Beyond this roll or pitch deflection you fly yourself; releasing holds the new spot.
propwash.ui.tune.hold.minSatellites.tip: With fewer satellites POSHOLD refuses and only holds altitude.
propwash.ui.number.invalid: Not a number – fix it or press Esc
propwash.ui.preset.apply.tip: Applies the chosen preset. Like every change here it is kept with “Save & close”.
propwash.ui.preset.copy.tip: Copies the chosen preset as a short code (starts with PWT1-) to the clipboard – for sharing in chat or on Discord.
propwash.ui.preset.delete.tip: Deletes the chosen preset of your own. Click twice.
propwash.ui.preset.full: At most %s own presets per tab
propwash.ui.preset.name: Preset name
propwash.ui.preset.name.missing: Type a new name into the field first
propwash.ui.preset.paste.invalid: No preset code (PWT1-…) on the clipboard
propwash.ui.preset.paste.tip: Adds the preset from a code on the clipboard to your own presets.
propwash.ui.preset.pid.choice.tip: Pick a preset – built-in or your own – and apply it with the button next to it. “Standard” returns gains, filters, throttle and hold settings to the values derived from the build. The arming angle is kept.
propwash.ui.preset.pid.save.tip: Keeps your changes on this tab as your own preset on this computer (config/propwash/tune_presets.json): hand-set PID gains, filters, throttle and hold settings. Works for every drone; the same name overwrites.
propwash.ui.preset.rates.save.tip: Keeps the current rates (rates type and all three axes) as your own preset on this computer (config/propwash/tune_presets.json). Works for every drone; the same name overwrites.
propwash.ui.preset.rename.tip: Gives the chosen preset of your own the name from the field.
propwash.ui.preset.taken: There already is a preset called “%s”
